rows.note: Use 煮食爐 as the all-purpose term for a stove-style cooker.

example.english: This cooker is broken, so I can't cook rice.
example.traditional: 呢個煮食爐壞咗，煮唔到飯。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zyu2 sik6 lou4 waai6 zo2 zyu2 m4 dou2 faan6

rows.note: Use 廚具 when referring generally to cooking equipment or utensils rather than a stove.

example.english: This cooking equipment is so complete that the cooker can handle any dish.
example.traditional: 呢套廚具好齊，煮咩都方便。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 ceoi4 geoi6 hou2 cai4 zyu2 me1 dou1 fong1 bin6
